messages:
jordan (Sales): Quick one from the ACME POC — they want an air-gapped deployment but with a very tight maintenance window. Can we outline what packaging options we can commit to and what upgrade cadence we can promise for the POC? Also they asked about offline license activation.
maria (Solutions): We can deliver either a full offline bundle (tar.gz + OCI images) or delta patch bundles. Full bundle = complete install, delta = binary + manifest diffs.
jordan (Sales): Do we have numbers on bundle size and typical time to apply/downtime for an upgrade?
samir (Eng - Runtime): Full bundle size depends on model artifacts. For a small model build we can get ~4–6GB. Large model variants 30–60GB. Delta patches typically <200MB if only runtime or config changes.
beatrice (Security): Asking now — how do we sign bundles and rotate keys? Customer requires ability to independently verify signatures without external connectivity.
samir (Eng - Runtime): We use cosign to sign OCI layers and a detached signature for tar bundles. For offline verification we provide the public verification key and a short verify script. Example verify command (run on their air-gapped host):
```
cosign verify --key ./redwood-pubkey.pem registry.local/acme/redwood:bundle-v1.2.0
sha256sum -c bundle-v1.2.0.sha256
```
maria (Solutions): For the POC we can supply an HSM-backed signing key on our side and export the public key. Key rotation policy: default 90 days, but for POC we can do manual rotation on request.
legal-ops: We'll need to attach the key usage and rotation terms to the SOW. Also confirm auditability — every offline activation must produce a signed activation token and a local log that we can request.
jordan (Sales): Can we do a faster cadence (biweekly) for the POC if they need frequent bugfixes?
samir (Eng - Runtime): We can commit to ad-hoc delta releases every 2 weeks for the duration of the POC. For production we recommend monthly security/patch cadence. Note upgrade steps are: stop service -> apply bundle -> runcache clear -> start service. Typical downtime for delta: ~30–120s. Full bundle: depends on untar + image load (~5–15min on standard infra).
beatrice (Security): Customer also asked about FIPS and KMS. We support FIPS-mode for cryptography libs; for offline keys they can supply their own public key to pin. KMS/HSM integrations are supported for Private deployments (we never export private keys if HSM is used).
jordan (Sales): Licensing activation offline: what flow do we support?
maria (Solutions): Offline license activation: we generate a signed license file bound to customer cluster ID. Activation steps: they POST the cluster ID via a secure channel (we can accept it over an encrypted SFTP drop or an enterprise portal), we return signed license blob. No outbound traffic required from their cluster to validate — the runtime validates the signed blob locally.
legal-ops: Need to confirm retention and escrow for signed licenses. Also add a clause for emergency hotfixes and SLAs in the SOW.
samir (Eng - Runtime): Operational notes: if they want delta updates via an offline registry mirror, we provide recommended rsync layout and a manifest generator. Example manifest generator usage:
```
./generate-manifest --bundle bundle-v1.2.0 --out manifest.json
```
deploy-bot: bundle.build 1837012380: created bundle-v1.2.0-poc (size 4.7GB) :package:
jordan (Sales): Perfect — next steps: I'll ask ACME to confirm max downtime and whether they want delta-only or full bundle for initial install. Also I'll loop in procurement for SOW edits. @maria @beatrice please prepare a short checklist we can send to them (signing, key rotation, license flow, downtime estimates, bundle sizes).
maria (Solutions): Will do, I'll draft a 1-page checklist and ping here by EOD. :thumbsup:
beatrice (Security): I'll add the key rotation + verification steps and the FIPS/KMS notes.
jordan (Sales): Thanks everyone — keeping this thread for the POC decisions.
